meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能自动打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图和提取页面信息,并把操作结果告诉你。
howto.when: 当你让它查资料、填表或截图等网页操作时;它认为浏览器有助于完成任务时也会主动使用。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我页面上有什么
say.note: Claude 会打开网址并总结页面内容。

say.text: 帮我在这个网页表单里填好用户名和密码
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填写。

say.text: 打开商品页,把标题和链接提取出来
say.note: Claude 会提取页面里的文字和链接。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a real browser to open URLs, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and report the results back.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask for web research, form filling, screenshots, or similar browser tasks, and also when Claude decides a browser would help with the task.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me what's on the page.
say_en.note: Claude opens the URL and summarizes the page.

say_en.text: Fill in the username and password on this web form.
say_en.note: Claude locates the inputs and fills them.

say_en.text: Open the product page and extract titles and links.
say_en.note: Claude extracts text and links from the page.
